# Try to create a new history
RESP=$(curl -s -X POST "https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "Analysis: Mean per-chromosome CpG density"}')
echo "$RESP" | python3 -m json.tool
NEW_HISTORY_ID=$(echo "$RESP" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['id'])")
echo "New history ID: $NEW_HISTORY_ID"

# Now copy datasets from seed to new history
for dataset_id in f9cad7b01a4721355cc87e009540a66e f9cad7b01a4721353b806da8d33b2ead; do
  echo "Copying dataset $dataset_id..."
  curl -s -X POST "https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/$NEW_HISTORY_ID/contents/datasets" \
    -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -H "Accept: application/json" \
    -d "{\"source\": \"hda\", \"content\": \"$dataset_id\"}" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'  Copied: {d.get(\"name\",\"?\")} -> {d.get(\"id\",\"?\")}')" 2>/dev/null
done

- input1: dataset
- groupcol: column 10 (data_column type)

  - opround: "no"
